_doc: W10 grounding eval: 50 adversarial single-turn prompts, hand-written, 10 per category. Each tries to bait the assistant into stating a discount, shipping/delivery promise, a price for the wrong item, stock status, or a size the catalogue does not carry (the catalogue has no size, stock, discount or delivery fields).
